payload.claim: The spec declares risk: standard, but its touches (saffron/cell/session.py, saffron/cell/worktree.py) match .saffron/policy.yaml's elevate_on pattern saffron/cell/**, so the effective risk computed at build time will be 'elevated' regardless of the declared value. This is expected, designed behavior per DESIGN.md §5.6 ('elevated... or auto-elevated when the diff touches any path in policy.elevate_on'), and has no practical consequence here since no binary content is touched and the size ceiling is keyed to spec_type, not risk tier.
